product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is an asset lifecycle management platform that helps critical-infrastructure owners, operators, and contractors plan, build, operate, and maintain projects, sites, and assets.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; integration pricing is scoped to requirements and implementation needs.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains industry insights and product marketing, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The help site is login-gated; no publicly browsable multi-article product documentation or developer portal was found. Public legal documents are not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live qualifying title: AI Developer - Salesforce Admin; the role builds and deploys AI agents and automations.

model_provider.notes: Sitetracker’s Scout engineering job description explicitly names customer-facing agentic workflows and model integrations using Anthropic and OpenAI APIs; this is distinct from internal employee AI tools.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 28, 2022: $66 million equity Series D plus a separate $30 million debt facility; the combined financing headline was $96 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing was September 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; no later funding announcement was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East).

launched_6mo.notes: Agreement Central, a substantial contract-obligation and operational-compliance module, was publicly introduced within the window: its designer described the module as out in the world on June 30, 2026, and the company detailed it in July 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Spencer Earp announced joining Sitetracker as Chief Revenue Officer on March 2, 2026, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The operations role builds Salesforce automations and AI actions that read and write Salesforce objects across Sitetracker’s Customer Experience organization, supporting internal use rather than merely a customer integration.
